title: 12 Best Milk Bars in Warsaw
description: Discover Warsaw's best milk bars (bary mleczne) for authentic, budget-friendly Polish cuisine. Our guide covers top spots for traditional pierogi, zupy, and classic communist-era charm.

places.name: Bar Mleczny Prasowy
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pierogi Ruskie (potato and cheese dumplings) and Rosół (chicken noodle soup).

places.name: Bar Mleczny Bambino
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Kotlet Schabowy (breaded pork cutlet) with mizeria (cucumber salad) and a kompot (fruit drink).

places.name: Bar Mleczny Gdański
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Naleśniki (crepes) with sweet cheese or fruit, and a side of traditional kapuśniak (cabbage soup).

places.name: Bar Mleczny Familia
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Placki Ziemniaczane (potato pancakes) with goulash, or a generous portion of Zrazy (beef rolls).

places.name: Bar Mleczny Miś
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Bigos (hunter's stew) – it's often simmering all day, developing rich flavors.

places.name: Bar Mleczny Sadyba
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Gołąbki (cabbage rolls) served with a rich tomato sauce and mashed potatoes.

places.name: Bar Mleczny Uniwersytecki
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Żurek (sour rye soup) and Kopytka (potato dumplings) with a sprinkle of sugar and butter.

places.name: Bar Mleczny WARS
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Leniewe Pierogi (lazy dumplings) – a simple, comforting dish of potato and cheese dumplings, often served with butter and sugar or sour cream.

places.name: Bar Mleczny Królewski
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Jajecznica (scrambled eggs) for a traditional Polish breakfast, or a simple Pomidorowa (tomato soup) for lunch.

places.name: Bar Mleczny Złota Kurka
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Kotlet Drobiowy (chicken cutlet) or a substantial piece of roasted chicken, often served with roasted potatoes.

places.name: Bar Mleczny Powszechny
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Kluski Śląskie (Silesian dumplings) with gravy, or the refreshing Chłodnik (cold beet soup) during warmer months.

places.name: Bar Mleczny Rondo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic set: Mielony (minced meat cutlet) with mashed potatoes and a side of buraczki (beetroot salad).
